parameters.content:
## A · Lead desk
Enquiries arrive at the webhook: from the form (workflow F), a portal or a WhatsApp bridge. Reads the enquiry with rules (no AI, no cost), checks the budget against DLD's post-war median price, sets Hot/Warm/Cold and drafts a reply.

Nothing is sent to the buyer: drafts wait in `desk/runtime/drafts/` for an agent. Every lead goes to `leads.csv`.

Telegram is off. To use it: add a Telegram credential, set TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, enable the node.
